The '''Dread Executioners camp''' was an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] outpost of the [[Dread Executioners]] located on [[Oricon]]. Established during the [[Dread War]], it served as a staging ground for all imperial operations on the moon, including the descent into the [[Dread Fortress]].<ref name="location" />

Leader of the Dread Executioners, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Hargrev]], tried to shield his camp from [[Dread Masters]]' influence. He and [[Maiya Vix]] instructed agents of the Empire in the field from the camp.<ref name="location" />

Military personnel stationed at the camp tasked with providing supplies included [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kantis]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeants]] [[Londar (Twi'lek)|Londar]] and [[Kidles (male)|Kidles]],<ref name="location" /> all three just off the [[CZ-198]], where they were [[Imperial Landing Zone|stationed]] previously.<ref name="CZ">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=location|[[CZ-198]]}}</ref> Several Imperial heroes of various origin passed through Oricon,<ref>{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|Imperial|Path to Madness}}</ref> some of them stopping at the camp to do trade. These included [[Dae'o Soset]], [[Halsia Banso]], [[Seibahn Vabakson]] and [[Traxalis Deagua]]<ref name="retired">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=other|Retired vendors from [[Oricon]]}}</ref>, as well as [[Barleos Choid]].<ref name="location" />
